newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finvest aims to boost pulp exchange.
newsitem.headline: Finvest aims to boost pulp exchange.

text.p: Finvest Oy, owner of forestry consultancy Jaakko Poyry, said on Wednesday it hoped its acquisition of a stake in Suomen Optioporssi Oy (SOP) would add credibility to SOP's planned pulp derivatives.
Finvest earlier said in a statement it had bought 19.1 percent of Finnish options exchange Suomen Optioporssi Oy, which plans to launch the world's first pulp derivatives trade on February 4.
"We hope of course that this will increase credibility," Finvest CEO Niilo Pellonmaa told Reuters by telephone.

He said Finvest's Jaakko Poyry had advised SOP on pulp issues. The planned pulp derivatives treat pulp as a commodity based on an index and can be used by the forest industry and its clients to hedge against pulp price fluctuations.
